built_from_inputs_note: This build is identified by a SHA-256 over every input file it read, not by a wall-clock time. Rebuilding from the same inputs produces this same stamp, which is what the CI reproducibility gate checks. The date of any given publication is the git commit date.

hyperparameters_fixed_before_running.note: Ridge and the home-field prior were fixed in the source file before the model was first executed. They are not tuned on the holdout. Changing them changes the file, which is visible in git.

source_note: Results and market lines come from nflverse/nfldata data/games.csv, the published mirror of Lee Sharpe's games table. Every market line is the single nflverse line, basis unspecified — see price_store.csv.
